CITY OF ALHAMBRA DESIGN REVIEW BOARD
  ACTION MINUTES

  Regular Meeting
  July 8, 2025

  The audio recording of the meeting is available here: DRB Meeting – July 8, 2025 (Audio)

A.  CALL MEETING TO ORDER:  7:00 P.M. in Conference Room A of Alhambra City Hall.

B.  ROLL CALL:

  Present:  Nora Hernandez, Chairman; Michael Daninger; Stanley Tsai; Jennifer Ng

  Absent:  Ankit Udani, Vice Chairman

  Staff Present: Steve Kuchenski, Secretary/City Architect; Eric Martinez, City Architect
  Representative

C.  CONSENT AGENDA:

  AGENDA
  ITEM 1:  MINUTES – June 24, 2025
  • Request: This is a request for the Design Review Board to approve
  the Minutes of the June 24, 2025, Regular Meeting of the Design
  Review Board.
  • Recommended Action: Design Review Board review and approve
  as submitted the Minutes of the June 24, 2025, Regular Meeting of
  the Design Review Board.

  MOTION:
  •  Moved to approve Consent Agenda Item 1.
  •  Moved by Board Member Daninger, Seconded by Board Member
  Tsai.
  •  The motion carried by the following roll call vote:

  Roll Call Vote: 4-0-0-1
  Ayes:  Hernandez, Daninger, Tsai, Ng
  Noes:  None
  Abstain: None
  Absent:  Udani

D.  DISCUSSION ITEMS:

  AGENDA
  ITEM 2:  DESIGN REVIEW BOARD DRB-25-080
  • 111 South Meridian Avenue & 301 Hampden Terrace
  • Applicant: Joshua Wong

  1
  07/08/2025
   •  Request: This is an application for window replacements on two (2)
  separate 1-story single-family residential dwellings on a single parcel.
  •  Recommended Action: APPROVE WITH CONDITIONS. The
  proposed project is approved with the following Conditions of
  Approval:

  1) Provide window grids that are permanently applied to the exterior
  of the glass and presents a true divided light appearance on the
  street facing windows of the South Meridian Avenue building.

MOTION:
  •  Moved to approve the application with the following Conditions of
  Approval:

  1) Provide window grids that are permanently applied to the exterior
  of the glass and presents a true divided light appearance on the
  street facing windows of the South Meridian Avenue building.
  2) For the street-facing windows along South Meridian to maintain
  its existing size.
  3) For window #102A, the applicant can work with city staff if this
  window needs to be relocated or resized to accommodate a
  potential kitchen re-design.

  •  Moved by Board Member Ng, Seconded by Board Member Tsai.
  •  The motion carried by the following roll call vote:

  Roll Call Vote: 4-0-0-1
  Ayes:  Hernandez, Daninger, Tsai, Ng
  Noes:  None
  Abstain: None
  Absent:  Udani

AGENDA
ITEM 3:  DESIGN REVIEW BOARD DRB-25-047
  • 801 West Commonwealth Avenue
  • Applicant: Jack Kaufman
  • Request: This is an application for exterior remodel and re-design of
  an existing 2-story 33-unit residential care facility for the elderly.
  • Recommended Action: APPROVE. The proposed project is
  approved without conditions.

MOTION:
  •  Moved to approve the application with the following Conditions of
  Approval:

  1) On the south elevation, provide decorative gable vents consistent
  with the proposed Spanish style.
  2) Update drafting error in-between the two front doors to accurately
  reflect the proposed wall finish.

  2
  07/08/2025
   3) Provide articulation or decorative wall element in-between the two
  front doors consistent with the proposed Spanish style.
  4) On the south elevation, increase the width of the arched openings
  to allow adequate space between the adjacent window frame and
  wall.
  5) Corbels / rafter tails to be painted to match the balcony brackets.
  6) Update the color and material board to show a more decorative
  railing design that is consistent with the Spanish style.

  •  Moved by Board Member Ng, Seconded by Board Member Tsai.
  •  The motion carried by the following roll call vote:

  Roll Call Vote: 4-0-0-1
  Ayes:  Hernandez, Daninger, Tsai, Ng
  Noes:  None
  Abstain: None
  Absent:  Udani

E.  ORAL COMMUNICATIONS:

  •  There were no Oral Communications.

F.  ADJOURNMENT:

  •  There being no other business, the meeting was adjourned at 8:01 P.M. to
  Tuesday, July 22, 2025, at 7:00 P.M.

  _____________________________
  Nora Hernandez
  Chairman
ATTEST:

_______________________
Steve Kuchenski
Secretary/City Architect
